title: Combined Logic: (A or B) and C
story: Conveyor interlock: The conveyor belt may run under MANUAL start OR AUTO enable, but in either case, the SAFETY GATE must be closed (GATE=1).
concept: Combining parallel and series logic: wire MANUAL and AUTO in parallel branches, and place GATE in series after their junction.

learn.title: Branching into Series
learn.text: To create (A OR B) AND C, parallel the A and B branches together first, then feed the combined wire through contact C before reaching the output.

tests.name: Conveyor runs when (MANUAL or AUTO) and GATE closed

steps.explanation: MANUAL pressed but GATE open -> Must NOT run!
MANUAL pressed with GATE closed -> CONVEYOR runs.
AUTO active but GATE open -> Must NOT run!
AUTO active with GATE closed -> CONVEYOR runs.

hints: Wire Rail L to both MANUAL and AUTO.
Join the right terminals of MANUAL and AUTO together, and connect to GATE's left terminal.
Connect GATE's right terminal to CONVEYOR, and CONVEYOR to Rail R.
